description: A one-bedroom on the east corner, glass on two sides: the bay on one and the long grey run of Coldwater on the other. Warm oak, a platform bed, a galley kitchen in grey stone, and the heating underfoot. Leave west to the landing.

window.description: A tall pane runs floor to ceiling down one wall, black-framed, holding the city out there like something in a case.
window.name: the window

name: Solenne Residence 8-B
